info.title: LayerX public JSON-RPC
info.description: Public JSON-RPC reads, authenticated activity submission and scoped WebSocket subscriptions. Native DID enumeration, asset listing/detail and canonical fee estimation forward to authenticated core reads; unavailable evidence is returned explicitly and balances, metadata or fees are never fabricated.

methods.name: lx_register
methods.description: Creates one self-service identity principal in the beta tenant. Both arguments are lowercase hexadecimal: a 32-byte Ed25519 signer public key and its 64-byte signature over SHA-256(len-prefixed "layerx-register-binding-v1", tenant, signer_public_key). The subject is derived as beta.<first 16 bytes of SHA-256(len-prefixed "layerx-register-subject-v1", tenant, signer_public_key)>, so registration is idempotent and cannot name another key holder's principal. The result is the identity principal record: tenant, sub, allowed_signer_public_keys, account and audiences. Malformed arguments are -32602; a signature that does not prove possession of the named key is -32002; the per-minute self-registration budget is -32005; an unconfigured or unavailable identity service is -32001 with a machine-readable data.code.

methods.name: lx_requestFunds
methods.description: Claims one testnet faucet grant for the authenticated identity principal and proxies it to the faucet service. Requires the same bearer identity session used to provision gateway keys; the signer public key must be one the session authorises, so a principal cannot fund a key it does not hold. The faucet bounds claims per principal per window, and the gateway derives the faucet idempotency key from SHA-256(len-prefixed "layerx-faucet-claim-v1", principal, did, signer_public_key), so a repeated request returns the same grant instead of a second one. The result is the faucet claim record: funded, funding_id, transaction_id, decimal-string amount and network; a claim whose evidence is incomplete is -32603 and is never reported as funded. Malformed arguments are -32602; a missing session, an unauthorised signer key or a faucet refusal is -32002; the per-minute claim budget and faucet quotas are -32005; a faucet that is unconfigured, unavailable or still settling is -32001 with a machine-readable data.code.

methods.name: lx_getAccount
methods.description: Reads one account by 32-byte hexadecimal account id through the public core account read. Returns name, asset_id, balance, next_sequence, frozen, and authenticated node evidence. Invalid selectors are JSON-RPC -32602. Missing or unverifiable evidence is -32001; the public read rate limit is -32005.

methods.name: lx_getBalance
methods.description: Same core account read as lx_getAccount. Clients that need only the current units use balance and asset_id from that object.

methods.name: lx_getBalances
methods.description: Enumerates the complete bounded DID account list from LNI minor 5 committed account reads. Returns did, accounts with canonical values, native proof material and freshness, and verification=authenticated_node_snapshot. No independently verified completeness or finality claim. Unavailable or invalid native evidence returns -32001.

methods.name: lx_getReceipt
methods.description: Reads the verified receipt for a 32-byte hexadecimal activity id. A successful result includes receipt bytes and result_code. Missing evidence is JSON-RPC -32001. An admission acknowledgement is never returned as success.

methods.name: lx_getActivityStatus
methods.description: Same receipt read as lx_getReceipt. Activity status is the receipt result state (completed, refused, or the upstream pending/unavailable refusal), not a separate status document.

methods.name: lx_getBatchHeader
methods.description: Reads a sequencer-signed batch header by nonzero decimal batch number. Leading zeros and the value 0 are invalid parameters.

methods.name: lx_getCheckpoint
methods.description: Reads checkpoint evidence by 32-byte hexadecimal checkpoint id. The all-zero identifier is refused.

methods.name: lx_getNodeInfo
methods.description: Handshake node information: protocol_version, network_id, chain_head_sequence, latest_sealed_batch, latest_finalised_checkpoint, authorised_sequencer_key, and advertised capabilities.

methods.name: lx_getSequence
methods.description: One account_id argument reads account next_sequence. With [did, "identity"], reads identity.next_sequence from the authenticated native preparation snapshot for envelope signing. Account and identity sequences are independent.

methods.name: lx_getProof

params.name: account_id
params.description: Required only when kind is account.

methods.description: Verified proof with canonical value and signed batch header. kind activity or receipt takes the activity id. kind account requires activity_id and account_id. Account proofs export the exact verified native proof bytes without reconstruction.

methods.name: lx_sendActivity

schema.description: At most 1048576 hexadecimal characters encoding 524288 bytes. The full JSON request including envelope, parameters and batch overhead remains subject to the 8388608-byte HTTP request bound; ingress may impose a smaller body bound.

methods.description: Requires an activity:write gateway key and the existing route scope for Programs activities. Admits strictly canonical Asset register (1), account_open (4), send (5), receive (6), grant_issue (7), grant_revoke (8), mint (10) and burn (11), plus Programs deploy (1), upgrade (2), call (3), transfer (5), account registration (6) and wind-down (7). Asset pause/unpause (2/3) are excluded and Asset ordinal 9 is reserved and refused. Uses activity-ID outer deduplication and preserves signed protocol idempotency. Returns a verified receipt for executed, verified inclusion for batched, and an exact matching verified checkpoint header for finalised; returns JSON-RPC -32001 with state=pending and requested_commitment when evidence is absent after the bounded wait; no success result or commitment downgrade is returned. An admission acknowledgement never establishes execution.

methods.name: lx_subscribe
methods.description: Authenticated GET /rpc/ws upgrade using Authorization: LayerX-Key. receipt:read scope for receipts; state:read for checkpoints and account. Server notifications use lx_subscription with params.subscription and params.result. At most 32 connections, 8 subscriptions per connection and 16 queued receipt wakes. Slow consumers and feed loss close with 1013; key revocation closes with 1008. Reconnect and reconcile through reads after closure; notifications are live, not a durable replay. Ping every 5 seconds, idle deadline 60 seconds, connection lifetime one hour. Browser Origin requests are refused. Core requires LAYERX_CORE_RECEIPT_EVENTS_TOKEN_FILE matching the gateway component token. Receipts originate from authenticated native commit waits; checkpoints and account snapshots refresh on wakes, checkpoints also on bounded wait expiry.

methods.name: lx_listAssets
methods.description: Returns assets, observed_head_sequence, state_root and verification=authenticated_committed_snapshot from typed LNI minor-5 AssetRead. The complete native list is bounded to 64 records; unsupported or unavailable evidence returns -32001. Snapshot authentication is not an independent Merkle proof.

methods.name: lx_getAsset
methods.description: Returns asset metadata, observed_head_sequence, state_root and verification=authenticated_committed_snapshot from typed LNI minor-5 AssetRead. Unknown assets or unavailable evidence return -32001. Amounts are decimal strings and identifiers and custody_reference are hexadecimal.

methods.name: lx_estimateFee

schema.description: At most 1048576 hexadecimal characters encoding 524288 bytes. The full JSON request including envelope, parameters and batch overhead remains subject to the 8388608-byte HTTP request bound; ingress may impose a smaller body bound.

methods.description: Strictly decodes any activity admitted by lx_sendActivity and returns fee as a decimal string, parameter_version, canonical_schedule as hexadecimal, canonical_bytes, observed_head_sequence, state_root and verification=authenticated_committed_snapshot from native FeeEstimate. The native committed schedule determines the canonical-envelope price for Asset 1/2/3/4/5/6/7/8/10/11 and Programs 1/2/3/5/6/7. A schedule requiring unavailable execution or storage units fails closed with -32001. Asset ordinal 9 is reserved and refused. This estimate does not reserve a fee or prove execution.
